headline: How a Dhaka Umrah operator managed 2,400 pilgrims in one season without spreadsheets
intro: A family-run Hajj and Umrah agency moved pilgrim registration, packages and instalments into TravelSuite ERP before its busiest season.
challenge: Pilgrim lists lived in several Excel files, instalments were tracked in a notebook and room allocation was done by hand the night before departure. Staff spent more time reconciling lists than serving pilgrims.
solution: Pilgrim register with passport, photo and documents
Packages linking flights, Makkah and Madinah hotels and transport
Instalment schedules with WhatsApp reminders
Group and room allocation exported for hotels
results: more pilgrims than the previous season
quote: We used to manage Umrah groups in Excel and payments in a notebook. Now every pilgrim, payment and message is in one place.

headline: A Chattogram consolidator grew to 180 sub-agents with a self-service B2B portal
intro: A ticketing consolidator replaced phone and WhatsApp bookings with an agent portal that controls credit automatically.
challenge: Every sub-agent booking came through a phone call or WhatsApp message, credit was given informally, and agent statements took days to prepare at month-end.
solution: B2B portal with net fares and instant ticketing
Credit limits and deposit wallets per agent
Markups by agent group and airline
Agent ledgers and statements on demand
results: new agents in the first year
quote: The B2B portal with agent credit limits let us grow our sub-agent network without hiring more accounts staff.

headline: A Sylhet tour operator now takes 40% of bookings online
intro: A domestic tour operator launched a booking website and a shared WhatsApp inbox connected to its packages and CRM.
challenge: Inquiries arrived on Facebook and personal phones, itineraries were retyped in Word for each customer, and popular departures were sometimes oversold.
solution: Package builder with day-by-day itineraries
Booking website with online payment
Shared inbox for WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram
Seat inventory per departure
quote: WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram chats land in one inbox and turn into CRM leads. Nobody misses an inquiry now.

headline: A Dubai OTA launched its booking site in 12 days with international payments
intro: A new online travel agency in the UAE needed flights, hotels and card payments live before the winter season.
challenge: The founders had supplier contracts but no booking website, no payment gateway and no back office to fulfil orders.
solution: Branded B2C website on their own domain
Stripe, Apple Pay and Google Pay at checkout
Flight and hotel supplier connections
AI assistant answering questions after hours
results: currencies on one site: AED, USD, BDT
quote: Setup, branding and payment gateway were done in under two weeks, and the support team answers quickly on WhatsApp.

metric: Every file tracked stage by stage
headline: A Dhaka visa centre cut status calls by tracking every file stage by stage
intro: A busy visa processing centre moved hundreds of monthly applications from paper files to tracked digital files.
challenge: Customers called several times a day asking for status, documents were sometimes missing at submission and nobody could see which staff member owned each file.
solution: Country and visa-type checklists
Stages with responsible staff for every file
Automatic SMS and WhatsApp status updates
Help desk tickets linked to applications
results: of files with a named owner
quote: Our visa team tracks every file stage by stage, and customers get updates automatically. Calls asking for status dropped sharply.

headline: A Kuala Lumpur travel desk automated approvals and monthly billing for corporate clients
intro: A corporate travel agency serving regional companies replaced email approvals and manual invoices with workflows and reports.
challenge: Approvals were chased over email, monthly invoices were compiled by hand from dozens of bookings, and clients kept asking for spend reports.
solution: Approval workflow for every trip request
Company accounts with monthly billing
Spend reports by department and cost centre
Tasks for ticketing and changes
quote: Month-end used to take a week of matching tickets with bank statements. Now the ledgers are ready on the first day.
